name: jat/versus
title: Versus
description: Two trace screens: four vendors out of phase versus one accountable lead.

heading.default: Most small businesses run on four vendors that never talk to each other.

lede.default: A designer built the site, a host runs it, an IT company "handles security", and an agency sends SEO reports. When something breaks, everyone points somewhere else.

leftText.default: Each vendor optimizes their own piece. Handoffs drop context, and nobody owns the whole system.

rightText.default: The engineer who architects your system also secures it, hosts it and answers when it needs attention.
